items.title: New OpenSSH Vulnerability
items.summary: It's a bad one , and it's been in the code for a decade: A newly disclosed flaw involving OpenSSH and musl, dubbed "*sshole," allows attackers to log in to certain Alpine Linux and other musl-based Linux accounts configured to block password authentication simply by entering an oversized password. "Oversized" means longer than 256 bytes. Details . Slashdot...
